changes.comment: The standalone CLI takes the hub's token from `--token <secret>` or the `YOLTRA_DEVTOOLS_TOKEN` environment variable (the flag wins), and refuses `--token` without a value instead of starting an open hub. A store presenting a store id that is already connected is refused with a handshake error naming the id, instead of silently replacing the first store's registration (after which events from both shared one id, commands reached only the newer store, and either one leaving removed the other). The refusal log reads "Rejected an extension handshake".
